DefaultHumanInterventionLoop: App Service (Web Apps)/Antares Functions FlexConsumption Loop
MitigationInstructions: Run these steps in Order.
Step 1 - Find the timestamp when incident is fired.
Step 2 - Use the Kusto Primary Query provided in the Incident discussion entries to check the current failures.

- To run the primary query, Use Kusto cluster name from the incident discussion entries in primary kusto query execution except for FlexConsumptionDashboardClusterStampMapping table in query, for FlexConsumptionDashboardClusterStampMapping use cluster from the query itself.

Step 3 - Run this primary kusto query every hour after incident is created for 3 Iterations by updating _endTime Variable in kusto query. For example: If Incident is created at 8 AM, _endTime variable will be for 3 iterations 9 AM, 10 AM and 11 AM and follow below logic to execute query
- If current time is more than 3 hours from Incident Created Date, execute all 3 iterations together
- Otherwise run kusto query every hour from Incident Creation
Step 4 - If no result is found in all 3 iterations for the Incident Stamp.post the details of your findings in the ICM incident in tabular format
- Check for SyncRequestSlot High Traffic
- Use Secondary Kusto Query with title 'Validate High Number of SyncRequestSlot Requests' from Incident discussion and replace _endTime variable with Incident Creation Time
- Execute the query and check if results shows count_ more than 100000
- If count_ is greater than 100000, that shows high traffic for SyncRequestSlots
- Otherwise, it doesn't reflect high volume for SyncRequestSlot operation
- Based on above logic, post in ICM discussion, if SyncRequestSlot high traffic is observed
- Check for Data Role Process Restart
- Use Secondary Kusto Query with title 'Determine DR Process Restart' from Incident discussion and replace _endTime variable with Incident Creation Time
- Execute the query and check if results shows different values for count_ variable
- If results contains different values for Count_ variable at different time, it shows Data Role Process restarted
- If results contains same value for Count_ variable for all time, it shows Data Role Process is not restarted

- Based on above logic, post in ICM discussion, if Data Role Process is restarted or not in below format. Example: if values in resuts are 4 and 5, then discussion can be like 'DataRole Pid counts varied between 4 and 5 Pids in a 10min bucket, showing DataRole VM or process restarted at least once'
- If in step 3 all iterations lead to no results from Primary query and either SyncRequestSlot high traffic is observed or Data Role process is restarted in step 4
- then mark the incident as Mitigated with the summary of your findings and update ICM fields How fixed as Transient
Step 5. Otherwise, post the details of your findings in the ICM incident in tabular format for Query Results and transfer the incident for Human Intervention.
